title: [Bug] Kernel crashes when API key is invalid
body: ### Checked other resources - [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue. - [x] I am sure the issue hasn't been already addressed by searching through https://github.com/agiresearch/AIOS/issues. - [x] The usage issue is not resolved by updating to the latest stable version in the main branch. ### Describe your current environment _No response_ ### Describe the bug **Problem** When an invalid API key is provided, the kernel crashes completely instead of returning an error message. **Expected Behavior** - Kernel should return an error message when API key is invalid - System should continue running **Current Behavior** - Kernel crashes and stops responding - Requires manual restart **Steps to Reproduce** 1. Start AIOS kernel 2. Set an invalid API key 3. Make any LLM request This affects system stability **Suggested Fix** Add proper error handling for invalid API key scenarios to prevent kernel crashes.

linked_prs.title: Fix: LLM API Key Error Handling
linked_prs.body: ## What's Changed - Added proper error handling for invalid API keys - Fixed response parsing for LiteLLM completion calls - Returns helpful error messages instead of crashing Fixes #426
